effect: The completed skin connects its vessels and nerves to the body, and the warm and cool views introduce its role in temperature control.
reaction: It was interesting that the same surface resists water loss while letting sweat out through pores.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the skin to the body brought its protective layer, sweat outlet and internal connections together. The warm and cool views also gave the finished model a new purpose.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the already-made sweat gland into its named slot was clear but felt repetitive after making the outlet.

surprise.text: I didn't expect the outer skin layer to have no blood vessels; its living cells get supplies from the tissue underneath.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The slots and pictures explained where the parts belonged, although the final fittings were mostly straightforward.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing the finished skin respond differently to warmth and cold makes me curious how the body controls those changes.
